verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Cognee is open source and can run 'the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever'. They document a single-command Docker deployment (cognee/cognee:main) and say the UI and all pipelines can run entirely on your own machine with no account via cognee.start_ui(). An offline CLI demo needs no API key or network. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and in-depth docs on production self-hosting such as scaling and backing-store configuration.
